According to Bloomberg reporter Mark Gurman, Apple is making major changes to its retail stores in preparation for an upcoming smart home product launch. Apple is expected to release the redesigned HomePod mini and Apple TV 4K as early as this autumn, but based on the related changes, it appears a third and more significant product will also debut at the same time.

Apple's smart home product line has accumulated a large backlog of unreleased items, mainly because the company's Siri overhaul project has been delayed multiple times. Now that the Siri integration is finally complete, some products that have not been updated for years can finally see the light of day.

However, sources indicate that Apple will first launch updated versions of the HomePod mini and Apple TV 4K, while the company's first smart home hub (also known as the HomePod with display or HomePad) may arrive a little later.

However, judging from the preparations at retail stores, this smart home hub may be launched alongside the updated Apple TV and HomePod mini. The Power On newsletter reads as follows:

Of course, we have to wait until Apple's September keynote to confirm. But based on today's report, we may soon get a glimpse of Apple's brand new smart home hub, which will debut alongside the Apple TV 4K and HomePod mini equipped with all-new Siri AI capabilities.

Summary

By the way, the rumoured Apple smart home hub is said to feature a 7-inch square display and come in two versions: one with a built-in speaker, and another with a magnet on the back for wall mounting. The product will run an entirely new operating system with widgets support on the home screen, can be used for FaceTime calls, and naturally will serve as the hub for all smart home accessories and Siri. It is also said to be equipped with an A18 chip.

Another new rumour about Apple's smart home product line is that the new Apple TV 4K may come with a redesigned Siri Remote, though the specific changes are currently unknown.

Which of the above new smart home products are you interested in picking up? Which one are you most looking forward to? Feel free to share your thoughts in the comments section.
